import os
import openpyxl

out_path = os.environ['OUT_XLSX']
print("OUT_XLSX:", out_path)

wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(out_path)
ws = wb['Sheet1']

# Table 1: C7:C11 (names), Table 2: L7:L11 (names), M7:N11 (values)
# Logic: Nth occurrence of a name in Table 1 maps to Nth occurrence of same name in Table 2

# Build occurrence index for Table 2
table2 = {}
for row in range(7, 12):
    name = ws.cell(row=row, column=12).value  # Column L
    if name:
        if name not in table2:
            table2[name] = []
        table2[name].append(row)

# Fill Table 1 rows 9-11 (rows 7-8 already filled)
table1_count = {}
for row in range(7, 12):
    name = ws.cell(row=row, column=3).value  # Column C
    if name:
        if name not in table1_count:
            table1_count[name] = 0
        table1_count[name] += 1
        occ = table1_count[name]  # 1-based occurrence
        
        if row >= 9:  # Only fill rows 9-11 (8 is already done)
            if name in table2 and occ <= len(table2[name]):
                src_row = table2[name][occ - 1]
                val1 = ws.cell(row=src_row, column=13).value  # Column M
                val2 = ws.cell(row=src_row, column=14).value  # Column N
                ws.cell(row=row, column=4).value = val1  # Column D
                ws.cell(row=row, column=5).value = val2  # Column E
                print(f"Row {row}: {name} (occ {occ}) -> Table2 row {src_row}: {val1}, {val2}")

wb.save(out_path)
print("Done")
